systems.owner: Ministry of Education; funded by the Government of Liberia through the Public Sector Investment Program
systems.tiers: monitoring officers capture geo-referenced data at schools; pilot phase to begin in Montserrado, Rivercess, Sinoe, Bomi and Gbarpolu counties

note: An inspection tool used by monitoring officers on school visits (teacher attendance, lesson plans, student registers, materials), not a system schools add learner records to; single-function, so no fact.
